issue_context.title: `systemd-update-utmp-runlevel.service` fails to start when running in parallel with daemon-reexec
issue_context.body:
### systemd version the issue has been seen with

latest main

### Used distribution

Fedora 37

### Linux kernel version used

_No response_

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

None

### Component

_No response_

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

_No response_

### Unexpected behaviour you saw

While writing a test for #27139 I noticed that when I run `systemctl daemon-reexec` in the boot transaction, sometimes the `systemd-update-utmp-runlevel.service` fails to start.

This can be reproduced quite easily with:

```diff
diff --git a/test/units/testsuite-01.service b/test/units/testsuite-01.service
index 1c81efc1b1..38695ff719 100644
--- a/test/units/testsuite-01.service
+++ b/test/units/testsuite-01.service
@@ -6,5 +6,5 @@ Wants=systemd-resolved.service systemd-networkd.service
 
 [Service]
 ExecStartPre=rm -f /failed /testok
-ExecStart=sh -e -x -c 'systemctl --state=failed --no-legend --no-pager >/failed ; systemctl daemon-reload ; echo OK >/testok'
+ExecStart=sh -e -x -c 'systemctl daemon-reexec; systemctl --state=failed --no-legend --no-pager >/failed ; systemctl daemon-reload ; echo OK >/testok'
 Type=oneshot
```

and running TEST-01-BASIC a couple of times:

```
[3643990.720955] H systemd[1]: Started systemd-logind.service.
[3643990.722379] H systemd[1]: Reached target multi-user.target.
[3643990.735120] H systemd[1]: Starting systemd-update-utmp-runlevel.service...
[3643990.736159] H systemd[1]: Starting testsuite-01.service...
[3643990.740128] H sh[35]: + systemctl daemon-reexec
[3643990.751097] H systemd[1]: Reexecuting.
[3643990.880216] H systemd-update-utmp[33]: Failed to get state: Connection reset by peer
[3643990.880818] H sh[35]: + systemctl --state=failed --no-legend --no-pager
[3643990.889197] H systemd[1]: systemd-update-utmp-runlevel.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
[3643990.889256] H systemd[1]: systemd-update-utmp-runlevel.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
[3643990.889557] H systemd[1]: Failed to start systemd-update-utmp-runlevel.service.
```

Is this expected? If so, I guess adding `After=systemd-update-utmp-runlevel.service` should, hopefully, be enough for the test to be happy again.

comments:
Note, similarly, the following script fails with the same error code.
```sh
#!/bin/bash

set -eux

systemctl daemon-reexec &
for ((i=0;i<10;i++)); do
    systemctl status -n 0 systemd-networkd.service
done
```

review_comments: Hmm, a better strategy would be to disconnect and try the whole thing anew on a new bus connection. (up to some limit). That way we can pretty reliable ensure that utmp will eventually be updated.
